description: This file contains utility functions related to network interfaces, MAC address generation, and IPv6 address derivation, primarily for Linux systems, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaceExists
methods.description: Checks if a network interface with the given name exists on the system.

methods.name: TapInterfacesInUse
methods.description: Returns a set of names of TAP interfaces currently in use on the system, by inspecting /proc and using grep.

methods.name: MacAddressToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a human-readable string.

methods.name: Ipv6ToString
methods.description: Converts a 16-byte IPv6 address to its string representation.

methods.name: GenerateMobileMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a mobile network interface based on an index.

methods.name: GenerateEthMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for an Ethernet interface based on an index.

methods.name: GenerateWifiMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a Wi-Fi interface based on an index.

methods.name: GenerateCorrespondingIpv6ForMac
methods.description: Generates a link-local IPv6 address from a MAC address following the EUI-64 format.
